description: Plan and Decide (plan §20.1) and the Release step at the end of a job (owner, 2026-10-18), each run alone with a StepContext the harness builds, like video-steps.cases.json (same request, outputs, config, drives, eject and expectations). Given also: probe ({disc: a generated listing, shared/scenarios/README.md} or {none: true}): Probe's output, the listing built with ListingBuilder and its Fingerprint.of; identify (true: the real Identify step runs first and its output is added; its log and calls are dropped); libraries {id: {path, offline {code, params}}} (LibraryPort.require: the handle, the offline reason thrown, library.notFound for one not listed); catalog [{id, libraryId, path, status, committedAt}] (CatalogQueries.archivedBefore gives them, in order, as committed units of the disc); files [paths that exist]; volumes {path: {id, free}} (FileSystem.volume); reserveFails {code, params} (SpaceReservations.reserve fails with it; absent: it works); answer (what DecisionPort.ask returns; absent: it fails with job.cancelled); finishing {outcome, error {code}} (the context's finishing). Calls are recorded in order: 'archivedBefore probe' (with Probe's fingerprint; another one is written out), 'reserve <volume> <path> <need> <free>', 'ask <id> <question code> <answer ids, comma-separated>', 'eject <device>'. Expect also: resources {drives, libraryWrites}; skipJob {code, params} (the report's reason to skip the job; null: none); appendSteps [kinds] (exactly; absent from a case: not checked); plan {mode, profileId, libraryId} (the report's plan); question {code, params} (the question asked). The listing's title numbers are MakeMKV's (0, 1, …); sizes in bytes. A day is the commit's UTC date.
